description: Shared costs for a flat, Splitwise-style. Whoever paid adds what it was for and how much. The cost is split evenly between everyone in the flat at that moment, and each person sees what they owe or are owed. Everyone who opens the board joins the flat. Each expense is recorded for the signed-in caller the server verified, never for a name in the request. Runs on an hkp-node kept under the name `node`.

state.schema:
-- Everybody who has opened the board: their verified address, and the name
-- the board's member list gives them. Others are shown the name, never the address.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS flatmate (
  email  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name   TEXT,
  joined TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expense (
  id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  -- Who paid: the signed-in caller, as the server that verified them said.
  paid_by TEXT,
  what    TEXT,
  -- Money is kept in cents so an even split never loses a fraction.
  cents   INTEGER,
  created TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS share (
  expense INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES expense (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  person  TEXT NOT NULL,
  cents   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (expense, person)
);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS an_expense_needs_a_payer
BEFORE INSERT ON expense
WHEN coalesce(NEW.paid_by, '') = ''
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'sign in to add an expense');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS the_payer_is_in_the_flat
BEFORE INSERT ON expense
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flatmate WHERE email = NEW.paid_by)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'only someone in the flat can add an expense');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS an_expense_says_what_it_was
BEFORE INSERT ON expense
WHEN coalesce(NEW.what, '') = ''
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'say what it was for, e.g. Groceries 42.50');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS an_expense_has_an_amount
BEFORE INSERT ON expense
WHEN NEW.cents IS NULL OR NEW.cents <= 0
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'end with how much it was, e.g. Groceries 42.50');
END;
-- The even split: one share per flatmate in the flat when the expense is
-- added. A leftover cent or two goes to whoever joined first.
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS split_evenly
AFTER INSERT ON expense
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO share (expense, person, cents)
  SELECT NEW.id, f.email,
         NEW.cents / n.c + CASE WHEN f.rk <= NEW.cents % n.c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM (SELECT email, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY joined, email) AS rk FROM flatmate) f,
         (SELECT count(*) AS c FROM flatmate) n;
END;
state.statement:
INSERT INTO flatmate (email, name)
SELECT $caller_email, $caller_name
 WHERE coalesce($caller_email, '') <> ''
-- The member list only names people on a shared board: anywhere else, the
-- name it gave last time stands.
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = coalesce(excluded.name, flatmate.name)

-- 'Groceries 42.50' -> what = 'Groceries', cents = 4250. The amount is the
-- number at the end; a comma works as the decimal point too.
WITH e(entry) AS (SELECT trim(coalesce($entry, ''))),
     p(head, amt) AS (
       SELECT rtrim(entry, '0123456789.,'),
              substr(entry, length(rtrim(entry, '0123456789.,')) + 1)
         FROM e
     )
INSERT INTO expense (paid_by, what, cents)
SELECT $caller_email,
       trim(rtrim(head, ' €$£')),
       CAST(round(CAST(replace(amt, ',', '.') AS REAL) * 100) AS INTEGER)
  FROM p
 WHERE $intent = 'add'

-- Only whoever paid may take an expense back; its shares go with it.
DELETE FROM expense
 WHERE $intent = 'remove'
   AND id = $expense
   AND paid_by = $caller_email

WITH me(email) AS (SELECT coalesce($caller_email, '')),
     b AS (
       SELECT me.email AS email,
              (SELECT coalesce(sum(cents), 0) FROM expense WHERE paid_by = me.email)
            - (SELECT coalesce(sum(cents), 0) FROM share WHERE person = me.email) AS c
         FROM me
     )
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN b.email = '' THEN 'Sign in to join the flat and add expenses.'
    WHEN b.c > 0 THEN 'You are owed ' || printf('%.2f', b.c / 100.0) || ' in total.'
    WHEN b.c < 0 THEN 'You owe ' || printf('%.2f', -b.c / 100.0) || ' in total.'
    ELSE 'You are all square.'
  END AS headline,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM flatmate) || ' in the flat · '
    || (SELECT count(*) FROM expense) || ' expenses' AS summary
FROM b

WITH me(email) AS (SELECT coalesce($caller_email, '')),
     t AS (
       SELECT f.email = me.email AS mine,
              coalesce(nullif(f.name, ''), 'A flatmate') AS name,
              (SELECT coalesce(sum(cents), 0) FROM expense WHERE paid_by = f.email) AS paid,
              (SELECT coalesce(sum(cents), 0) FROM share WHERE person = f.email) AS owed,
              f.joined AS joined
         FROM flatmate f CROSS JOIN me
     )
SELECT
  CASE WHEN mine THEN 'You' ELSE name END AS who,
  CASE
    WHEN paid - owed > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN mine THEN 'are owed ' ELSE 'is owed ' END) || printf('%.2f', (paid - owed) / 100.0)
    WHEN paid - owed < 0 THEN (CASE WHEN mine THEN 'owe ' ELSE 'owes ' END) || printf('%.2f', (owed - paid) / 100.0)
    ELSE (CASE WHEN mine THEN 'are settled up' ELSE 'is settled up' END)
  END AS status,
  'paid ' || printf('%.2f', paid / 100.0) || ' · their share ' || printf('%.2f', owed / 100.0) AS detail
FROM t
ORDER BY paid - owed DESC, joined

WITH me(email) AS (SELECT coalesce($caller_email, ''))
SELECT
  e.id AS id,
  e.what AS what,
  printf('%.2f', e.cents / 100.0) AS amount,
  'Paid by ' || CASE WHEN e.paid_by = me.email THEN 'you' ELSE coalesce(nullif(f.name, ''), 'a flatmate') END
    || ' on ' || date(e.created)
    || ' · split ' || (SELECT count(*) FROM share s WHERE s.expense = e.id) || ' ways' AS detail,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM share s WHERE s.expense = e.id AND s.person = me.email)
      THEN 'your share ' || printf('%.2f', (SELECT s.cents FROM share s WHERE s.expense = e.id AND s.person = me.email) / 100.0)
    ELSE 'not split with you'
  END AS yours,
  CASE WHEN e.paid_by = me.email THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS locked,
  'Remove "' || e.what || '" (' || printf('%.2f', e.cents / 100.0) || ') for everyone?' AS removePrompt
FROM expense e
CROSS JOIN me
LEFT JOIN flatmate f ON f.email = e.paid_by
ORDER BY e.created DESC, e.id DESC
LIMIT 200
